let Timer = 0
Timer = 600000
loops.everyInterval(Timer, function () {
    basic.showLeds(`
        . . # . .
        . # # # .
        # # # # #
        # # # # #
        . # # # .
        `)
    music.play(music.stringPlayable("C5 C5 A F B G G G ", 180), music.PlaybackMode.UntilDone)
    Timer = randint(60, 90) * 10000
    basic.clearScreen()
})
